title: Healthy Tiger: actual toolbox pickup, quick hammer swings and held swings
caption: TOOLBOX + HAMMER / ORDINARY LMB / NO DAMAGED TARGET
input_audit: Derived from toolkit_pickup_putdown.v1.json's ordinary loader source-target pickup. This uses the lighter act-0 training world and the same source Tiger toolbox/hammer geometry; winter stowage has no Panzerfaust rack and no rack-count expectation is copied. Only enemy removal and starting station are staged. Named look actions rotate the existing head, without moving the body or equipping tools. The 0.3 s LMB picks up the actual box and is released; separate 70 ms LMB clicks at 1.9 and 2.5 s then a 1.2 s hold must swing the carried hammer. The Tiger is healthy: no module damage, repair target or repair success is injected.
historical_scope: Disclosed input/animation regression in the training arena, not a historical encounter or proof of repairing a broken traverse mechanism.
visual_acceptance: The source toolbox is picked up with ordinary LMB; the pickup press does not swing. The full-size hammer remains visible in the right hand after looking toward the tray.
Each released quick click visibly starts a swing; holding LMB repeats swings. Both animations occur without a valid damaged target, with no fabricated repair impact sound or repair credit.
Inspect actual first-person hand/tool clearance and whole swing path at normal speed. Positive phase telemetry alone is not visual approval.
